cases.title: Driver Sign On — Manual, first use
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** you press Enter, key in the Staff ID and PIN, confirming each with Enter
-> **THEN** each PIN digit is masked with a '*' as you type it
**AND** the ETM authenticates the operator against the authorised user list
**AND** the First Use Safety Check screen is displayed
**WHEN** you confirm the bus has been safety checked and answer No to the Any Defects prompt
**AND** at Duty Number you enter an invalid duty, then the valid duty 4021, confirming with Enter
-> **THEN** the invalid duty is rejected on entry
**AND** the valid duty advances to Route Selection
**WHEN** you select route 10A by letters or number, with inbound and outbound journeys filtered
**AND** you select journey 1030, entering an invalid journey number first, then confirm the Route Summary
-> **THEN** the invalid journey number is rejected
**AND** the Message of the Day is displayed, or its Unavailable fallback after the 5-second timeout
**WHEN** you confirm the Message of the Day, then confirm the Word and Colours of the Day (or its Unavailable fallback after 5 seconds)
-> **THEN** the FLU screen is displayed for 10A
**AND** the start of shift is audited
**AND** the running total is recorded
**WHEN** you open the shift in CloudFare Estate Management
-> **THEN** a Start of Shift entry identifies the Driver, duty 4021 and vehicle
**AND** the shift details and defect record for the shift can be identified

cases.title: Driver Sign On — Smartcard, first use
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** you present the Staff pass to the reader
-> **THEN** the operator sign-on screen is displayed with the Staff ID pre-populated
**AND** the PIN field is highlighted for entry
**WHEN** you enter the valid PIN and confirm with Enter, then remove the Staff pass
-> **THEN** the ETM authenticates the operator and displays the First Use Safety Check screen
**WHEN** you open the device's Activity Log in CloudFare Estate Management
-> **THEN** a Start of Shift entry for the Driver is recorded at the time of the sign-on

cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** you attempt to change the boarding stage while inside the current stop GPS footprint or above 20 kph
**AND** you then move outside the footprint below 20 kph and change the boarding stage, and also set a boarding stage by entering its stage ID
-> **THEN** the boarding stage does not change while inside the footprint or above 20 kph
**AND** the boarding stage changes once outside the footprint below 20 kph, or immediately when set by stage ID
**WHEN** you page through the alighting stages
-> **THEN** the alighting stages page five at a time
**AND** the final stage on the route stays reachable at the end of the list

**WHEN** you attempt to page forward past the route's last stop (already at Last Boarding Stage)
-> **THEN** an error tone plays and FLU Home stays displayed
**WHEN** you press the star key
-> **THEN** nothing happens and FLU Home stays displayed

cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** you interrupt power momentarily and restore it
-> **THEN** the ETM returns the user to the screen they were originally on
**WHEN** you interrupt power for a prolonged period past the backup window
-> **THEN** the ETM saves its state and shuts down once the backup period is reached

cases.title: Power loss recovery — within and outside the recovery period
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** you lose power and restore it within the recovery period
-> **THEN** the ETM recovers to the signed-in state (10A FLU, same Driver)
**WHEN** you lose power and restore it outside the recovery period
-> **THEN** the ETM recovers to the break state appropriately
**WHEN** you lose power while in break mode and restore it
-> **THEN** the ETM recovers to the break state appropriately
**WHEN** you open the device's Activity Log in CloudFare Estate Management
-> **THEN** the power-loss and recovery entries are recorded for the device

cases.title: Power — charging state on boot
cases.custom_steps:

cases.title: Power Saving Mode — entering and leaving
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the conditions to enter Power Saving Mode are met
-> **THEN** the ETM enters Power Saving Mode
**WHEN** you wake the ETM
-> **THEN** the ETM leaves Power Saving Mode and returns to its prior state

cases.title: Scheduled Maintenance — suspend and idle
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the ETM is in idle mode during the maintenance window

**WHEN** the ETM comes out of suspend

cases.title: Printer — out of service error

cases.title: Printer — firmware update download

cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the comms-lock threshold is reached

**WHEN** the ETM downloads a configuration with a future activation date

cases.title: Software distribution and fare-mode transition

**WHEN** you open the device's Activity Log in CloudFare Estate Management
-> **THEN** the fare-mode transition entry is recorded for the device

cases.title: Upload audit files and data to the back office
cases.custom_steps:

-> **THEN** the audit files are uploaded
**AND** the operational data is uploaded

cases.title: Time change — GMT and BST transitions
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the GMT-to-BST change occurs

-> **THEN** the ETM clock falls back correctly
**WHEN** you open the device's Activity Log in CloudFare Estate Management

cases.title: Status bar — cellular network status
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the cellular network status changes

cases.title: Auto Sign-Off — Driver signed off on the configured condition
cases.custom_steps:

cases.title: ZZ_DELETE_REVIEW - Smartcard — concessionary pass validation
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** you present a valid pass
-> **THEN** the valid concessionary pass validates for free travel
**WHEN** you present an invalid pass, then re-present a valid pass to exercise passback override where allowed
-> **THEN** the invalid pass is rejected with the reason
**AND** passback override is allowed where the pass rules permit it
Data variations: 60+, Senior, ROI Senior, Blind, War Pensioner, Half-Fare (DLA / Partially Sighted / Learning Disability / No Driving Licence / PIPS), Free Smartpass, Staff / Spouse / Dependants / Retired / External Staff, EA Bus & Rail Pupil + Further Education (start/expiry/weekend/holiday/time-band rules).
